knowledgeLocks.rule: Authorization and prior knowledge are independent axes.
PRIM2 identity/architecture, Hana's truth (NIS, GLASSHOUSE causality), Benji's history and JANUS origin, and the final succession stay unrevealed (proposal §2.6).

Real news may create supplementary fictional dispatches, never rewrite this fixed mission or attach allegations to a country/agent.

One operator on the PLAY board: Aya. Nusrat and Miguel act only through comms and WATCH; no second operator is ever spawned to rescue the board.
Concealment and cover are abstract game states. No real evasion, pretexting procedure or intrusion is taught (proposal §3.3 rule 6).

adapterPolicy.balance: No HP, damage, range, movement or AP numbers here. Values come from the canonical resolver and the level; prototype values are reference only (attributes matrix DECISIONS-2026-11-03 §1).
adapterPolicy.clocks: Approach / Window / Extract come from game/LVL-02-PERMISSION-SLIP.md 'Mission clocks'; the solo revision sets them. Not restated here.
adapterPolicy.tControl: T kit at level 1: sidearm holstered; JAM, TAKE CONTROL, SYNC PULSE once; machines only, people are never targets (game/TACTICAL-T-CONTROL-RULES.md on branch claude/t-control-rules-20261102).
adapterPolicy.storage: No second engine, backend or database. Events bind through the existing resolver and campaign ledger.
adapterPolicy.presentation: No purple; no drawn or substitute logo; country badges are on-screen chips only.

dataContract.purpose: Declarative content proposal for an existing Prim3 adapter; not a second simulation engine.
dataContract.conditionSemantics: requiresAll names facts which must exist in authoritative scenario state. Route/phase gating also applies. Never evaluate them as arbitrary code.
dataContract.effectsSemantics: set, append_unique, add_fact, narrative_event and require_adapter_evaluation are declarative adapter contracts; no direct writes from reading JSON.
dataContract.draftNumbers: No weapon, HP, range or movement balance supplied. Qualitative event directions need explicit mapping to the current campaign ledger.
dataContract.danger: Never allow a caller to set knowledge facts, scope approvals or verification results merely by submitting a preferred outcome.
dataContract.phaseGating: Choices and actions may appear only in their scene/phase; D10 additionally requires bounded_extension, D11 authorized_inference, D12 qualifying emergency; later recovery may deliberately change route with logged provenance. Repeated actions cannot duplicate permanent effects.
dataContract.sourceEvaluation: Approval/identity/observed truth/verification/safety predicates require an authoritative scenario event or authored fixture evaluation. A client cannot submit them as arbitrary successful values.
